in_sanskrit.name: Tanha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Desire, Longing
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Tanha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Tanu', meaning 'longing for', 'desire', or 'craving'. The name Tanha evokes feelings of deep yearning, nostalgia, and melancholy. It is a name that resonates with those who feel a profound sense of loneliness, and a strong desire to be close to their loved ones.
